verdict.rationale: A GPU accelerator would not normally offer user-facing automations. However, the ecosystem docs list Spur, an "AI-native job scheduler" that is drop-in compatible with Slurm, and a Kubernetes GPU Operator, so unattended background batch jobs can be scheduled on MI355X infrastructure. This is cluster workload scheduling rather than agent-style automations, and each tool gets only a one-line mention. Missing for 10: documented trigger- or schedule-based autonomous automation workflows, detail on how Spur jobs are configured and monitored unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
